mapper.insert: insert into `team`(name, leader_id, max_size, category, status) values(#{name}, #{leaderId}, #{maxSize}, #{category}, 'normal')
mapper.select: select id, name, leader_id, max_size, category, status, create_time from `team` where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into `team_member`(team_id, user_id, role, status, join_time) values(#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: select team_id, user_id, role, status, join_time from `team_member` where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from `team_member` where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update `team_member` set status = #{status}, join_time = NOW() where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId}
update `team_member` set role = #{role} where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from `team_member` where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 'approved'

select m.user_id, m.role, m.join_time, u.nickname, u.username from `team_member` m left join `user` u on u.id = m.user_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.status = 'approved' order by (m.role = 'leader') desc, m.join_time asc
select m.user_id, m.join_time, u.nickname, u.username from `team_member` m left join `user` u on u.id = m.user_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.status = 'pending' order by m.join_time asc

select t.id, t.name, t.category, t.max_size, t.leader_id, (select count(*) from `team_member` m where m.team_id = t.id and m.status = 'approved') as member_count, u.nickname as leader_nickname, (select m.role from `team_member` m where m.team_id = t.id and m.user_id = #{userId}) as my_role, (select m.status from `team_member` m where m.team_id = t.id and m.user_id = #{userId}) as my_status from `team` t left join `user` u on u.id = t.leader_id where t.status = 'normal'
and t.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and t.category = #{category}
order by member_count desc, t.id desc

select t.id, t.name, t.category, t.max_size, t.leader_id, (select count(*) from `team_member` m where m.team_id = t.id and m.status = 'approved') as member_count, u.nickname as leader_nickname, (select m.role from `team_member` m where m.team_id = t.id and m.user_id = #{userId}) as my_role, (select m.status from `team_member` m where m.team_id = t.id and m.user_id = #{userId}) as my_status from `team` t left join `user` u on u.id = t.leader_id where t.status = 'normal' order by member_count desc, t.id desc limit 20

select t.id, t.name, t.category, t.max_size, t.leader_id, (select count(*) from `team_member` m where m.team_id = t.id and m.status = 'approved') as member_count, u.nickname as leader_nickname, m.role as my_role from `team_member` m join `team` t on t.id = m.team_id left join `user` u on u.id = t.leader_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'approved' and t.status = 'normal' order by m.join_time desc
